displayName: reCAPTCHA broken — bot gate failing open

documentation.content: The reCAPTCHA Enterprise assessment API rejected event-photo-api's configuration (HTTP 400/401/403/404: invalid or wrongly-restricted API key, wrong project, API disabled). The api FAILS OPEN on this, so the download and Find-Me routes have NO bot gate until it is fixed. This exact failure went unnoticed from 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-02. The log entry's `jsonPayload.api` carries Google's error status/reason (never the key). Fix: add a new version of the `RECAPTCHA_KEY` secret from a valid API key restricted to recaptchaenterprise.googleapis.com, then redeploy — see cloud-webapp/BOT_PROTECTION_PLAN.md.
